pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Simple postures? (1 mark)
   A. Say Simple postures has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Simple postures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Simple postures.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings.
   B. Use The Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Use Names of Scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures.
   D. Say Names of Scriptures has no place in daily life.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

8. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   C. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Places of Worship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Places of Worship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Places of Worship has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of Worship.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Simple postures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Places of Worship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. C — Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. C — Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Simple postures; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Myself; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Places of Worship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
